# ScreenVault — Landing Page Build Instructions

## Overview

Build a single-page landing site for **ScreenVault**, a massive UI/UX design inspiration library (400,000+ screenshots). The audience is product designers and design teams who need fast reference material. The page must convert visitors into free or paid users by demonstrating the library's depth, powerful search, and workflow integrations.

## Tone & Visual Direction

Think **clean, contemporary SaaS** — generous whitespace, crisp typography, and a neutral palette (white/off-white backgrounds, near-black text, subtle grays). Use a single vibrant accent color (electric blue or violet) for CTAs and interactive highlights. Typography should feel premium: a geometric or grotesque sans-serif (Inter, General Sans, or similar). Rounded corners on cards and pills; soft shadows. The overall mood is *"polished design tool"* — the site itself should feel like something a designer would respect.

## Key Priorities

1. **Interactions are the core experience.** The animated stat counters, search tab switching, filter pills, and flows toggle must feel responsive and polished — these demonstrate the product's power. Use smooth transitions (200–300ms easing) and make sure tab/filter state changes are visually obvious.

2. **Testimonials & brand marquees** should create a sense of momentum — continuous, buttery-smooth horizontal scrolling that reinforces social proof without requiring user effort.

3. **Stats section** needs to land with impact. The counting animation should trigger on scroll-into-view and feel satisfying (ease-out, staggered start).

4. **Responsive design is non-negotiable.** The screenshot grids, filter pill rows, and multi-row testimonial carousels must gracefully adapt from desktop to mobile.

5. **Hero clarity** — the headline, one-liner, and dual CTAs ("Join for free" + "See our plans") must be immediately scannable above the fold.

Refer to `task_input.json` for the full section order, interaction specs, data values, and navigation definitions.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for structural requirements, data placement, and interaction definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output all files to `/app/output/`. `index.html` must be the main entry point.
2. All pages must be openable directly in a browser (no build step needed). Use relative paths for inter-page links.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — make professional judgments autonomously. Do not pause, ask questions, or wait for replies.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `site.tone`, `site.audience`, etc., use them to choose styles, layouts, and color schemes. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

{"type": "text", "text": "Base directory for this skill: /logs/agent/sessions/skills/frontend-design

# Frontend Design Skill

Use this skill when creating UI components, landing pages, dashboards, or any frontend design work.

## Design Workflow

Follow this structured approach for UI design:

1. **Layout Design** — Think through component structure, create ASCII wireframes
2. **Theme Design** — Define colors, fonts, spacing, shadows
3. **Animation Design** — Plan micro-interactions and transitions
4. **Implementation** — Generate the actual code

### 1. Layout Design

Before coding, sketch the layout in ASCII format:

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│         HEADER / NAV BAR            │
├─────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                     │
│            HERO SECTION             │
│         (Title + CTA)               │
│                                     │
├─────────────────────────────────────┤
│   FEATURE   │  FEATURE  │  FEATURE  │
│     CARD    │   CARD    │   CARD    │
├─────────────────────────────────────┤
│            FOOTER                   │
└─────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### 2. Theme Guidelines

**Color Rules:**
- NEVER use generic bootstrap-style blue (#007bff) — it looks dated
- Prefer oklch() for modern color definitions
- Use semantic color variables (--primary, --secondary, --muted, etc.)
- Consider both light and dark mode from the start

**Font Selection (Google Fonts):**
```
Sans-serif: Inter, Roboto, Poppins, Montserrat, Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans, DM Sans, Space Grotesk
Monospace: JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, Source Code Pro, IBM Plex Mono, Space Mono, Geist Mono
Serif: Merriweather, Playfair Display, Lora, Source Serif Pro, Libre Baskerville
Display: Architects Daughter, Oxanium
```

**Spacing & Shadows:**
- Use consistent spacing scale (0.25rem base)
- Shadows should be subtle — avoid heavy drop shadows
- Consider using oklch() for shadow colors too

### 3. Theme Patterns

**Modern Dark Mode (Vercel/Linear style):**
```css
:root {
  --background: oklch(1 0 0);
  --foreground: oklch(0.145 0 0);
  --primary: oklch(0.205 0 0);
  --primary-foreground: oklch(0.985 0 0);
  --secondary: oklch(0.970 0 0);
  --muted: oklch(0.970 0 0);
  --muted-foreground: oklch(0.556 0 0);
  --border: oklch(0.922 0 0);
  --radius: 0.625rem;
  --font-sans: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
}
```

**Neo-Brutalism (90s web revival):**
```css
:root {
  --background: oklch(1 0 0);
  --foreground: oklch(0 0 0);
  --primary: oklch(0.649 0.237 26.97);
  --secondary: oklch(0.968 0.211 109.77);
  --accent: oklch(0.564 0.241 260.82);
  --border: oklch(0 0 0);
  --radius: 0px;
  --shadow: 4px 4px 0px 0px hsl(0 0% 0%);
  --font-sans: DM Sans, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: Space Mono, monospace;
}
```

**Glassmorphism:**
```css
.glass {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
  border-radius: 1rem;
}
```

### 4. Animation Guidelines

**Micro-syntax for planning:**
```
button: 150ms [S1→0.95→1] press
hover: 200ms [Y0→-2, shadow↗]
fadeIn: 400ms ease-out [Y+20→0, α0→1]
slideIn: 350ms ease-out [X-100→0, α0→1]
bounce: 600ms [S0.95→1.05→1]
```

**Common patterns:**
- Entry animations: 300-500ms, ease-out
- Hover states: 150-200ms
- Button press: 100-150ms
- Page transitions: 300-400ms

### 5. Implementation Rules

**Tailwind CSS:**
```html
<!-- Import via CDN for prototypes -->
<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
```

**Flowbite (component library):**
```html
<link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/flowbite@2.0.0/dist/flowbite.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/flowbite@2.0.0/dist/flowbite.min.js"></script>
```

**Icons (Lucide):**
```html
<script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest/dist/umd/lucide.min.js"></script>
<script>lucide.createIcons();</script>
```

**Images:**
- Use real placeholder services: Unsplash, placehold.co
- Never make up image URLs
- Example: `https://images.unsplash.com/photo-xxx?w=800&h=600`

### 6. Responsive Design

Always design mobile-first and responsive:

```css
/* Mobile first */
.container { padding: 1rem; }

/* Tablet */
@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .container { padding: 2rem; }
}

/* Desktop */
@media (min-width: 1024px) {
  .container { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; }
}
```

### 7. Accessibility

- Use semantic HTML (header, main, nav, section, article)
- Include proper heading hierarchy (h1 → h2 → h3)
- Add aria-labels to interactive elements
- Ensure sufficient color contrast (4.5:1 minimum)
- Support keyboard navigation

### 8. Component Design Tips

**Cards:**
- Subtle shadows, not heavy drop shadows
- Consistent padding (p-4 to p-6)
- Hover state: slight lift + shadow increase

**Buttons:**
- Clear visual hierarchy (primary, secondary, ghost)
- Adequate touch targets (min 44x44px)
- Loading and disabled states

**Forms:**
- Clear labels above inputs
- Visible focus states
- Inline validation feedback
- Adequate spacing between fields

**Navigation:**
- Sticky header for long pages
- Clear active state indication
- Mobile-friendly hamburger menu

---

## Quick Reference

| Element | Recommendation |
|---------|---------------|
| Primary font | Inter, Outfit, DM Sans |
| Code font | JetBrains Mono, Fira Code |
| Border radius | 0.5rem - 1rem (modern), 0 (brutalist) |
| Shadow | Subtle, 1-2 layers max |
| Spacing | 4px base unit (0.25rem) |
| Animation | 150-400ms, ease-out |
| Colors | oklch() for modern, avoid generic blue |

---

*Based on SuperDesign patterns — https://superdesign.dev*"}

1	# ScreenVault — UI & UX design inspiration for mobile & web apps
2	
3	## Brand
4	ScreenVault is a comprehensive design inspiration library for UI/UX designers, product designers, and design teams. It offers a fully searchable collection of mobile and web app screenshots, user flows, and UI elements to accelerate design research and decision-making. The tone is modern, minimal, and professional.
5	
6	Brand colors: #141414 (primary dark), #FFFFFF (background white), #F5F5F5 (light gray surface)
7	
8	## Announcement Bar
9	2025 ScreenVault Awards — Celebrating the best on the internet.
10	
11	## Hero Content
12	Title: Discover real-world design inspiration.
13	Subtitle: Featuring over 1,000 iOS & Web apps, and 200 sites — New content weekly.
14	Primary CTA: "Join for free"
15	Secondary CTA: "See our plans"
16	
17	Navigation links: Pricing · Awards · Log in
18	
19	## Social Proof
20	Trusted by design teams at: (display as logo row of well-known tech/design companies)
21	
22	## Library Statistics
23	A growing library of:
24	- **1,150** apps
25	- **615,900** screens
26	- **329,200** flows
27	
28	These numbers animate with a counting effect when the section scrolls into view.
29	
30	## Search Categories
31	Filter pill categories available for browsing design patterns:
32	- Profile
33	- Wallet
34	- Welcome
35	- Account Setup
36	- Home
37	- Subscription & Paywall
38	- Login
39	- Settings
40	- Checkout
41	- Collections
42	
43	Pills are displayed in a horizontally scrollable row and update the screenshot grid when selected.
44	
45	## Feature Tabs
46	Tab navigation options within the search feature section:
47	- **Screens** — Browse full-screen captures of real apps
48	- **UI Elements** — Explore individual components and patterns
49	- **Flows** — View connected sequences of screens
50	- **Text in Screenshot** — Search by visible on-screen copy
51	
52	Clicking a tab switches the content area to show the corresponding search results view.
53	
54	## Feature: Search
55	**Find design patterns in seconds.**
56	The search feature section combines the tab navigation (Screens, UI Elements, Flows, Text in Screenshot) with filter pills to let users quickly narrow down relevant design references from the library. The grid of screenshot results updates dynamically based on the active tab and selected filter category.
57	
58	## Feature: Flows
59	**Explore entire user journeys with flows.**
60	
61	- **Videos** — Experience flows the way they were meant to be experienced, complete with transitions, micro-interactions, and animations.
62	- **Prototype mode** — Walk through flows, step by step, by using the interactive hotspots at your own preferred pace.
63	
64	A toggle switches between the Videos view and the Prototype mode view.
65	
66	## Inspiration Tools
67	**From inspiration to creation.**
68	
69	- **Copy to Figma** — Download designs you like or copy them straight into Figma with our new Figma plugin.
70	- **Save to collections** — Collect your favorite designs and upload your own screenshots into one place.
71	- **Leave comments** — Take notes upon saving so you'll never forget the context in the future.
72	
73	Each tool is presented as a feature card with a visual preview and short description.
74	
75	## Testimonials
76	**What our users are saying.**
77	
78	Displayed as a multi-row, auto-scrolling marquee carousel of testimonial cards.
79	
80	- **Sebastian Speier**, Shop — "ScreenVault is a great resource and it always comes in handy to see what the best practices or standards are for mobile patterns in our current landscape."

# ScreenVault — UI & UX design inspiration for mobile & web apps

## Brand
ScreenVault is a comprehensive design inspiration library for UI/UX designers, product designers, and design teams. It offers a fully searchable collection of mobile and web app screenshots, user flows, and UI elements to accelerate design research and decision-making. The tone is modern, minimal, and professional.

Brand colors: #141414 (primary dark), #FFFFFF (background white), #F5F5F5 (light gray surface)

## Announcement Bar
2025 ScreenVault Awards — Celebrating the best on the internet.

## Hero Content
Title: Discover real-world design inspiration.
Subtitle: Featuring over 1,000 iOS & Web apps, and 200 sites — New content weekly.
Primary CTA: "Join for free"
Secondary CTA: "See our plans"

Navigation links: Pricing · Awards · Log in

## Social Proof
Trusted by design teams at: (display as logo row of well-known tech/design companies)

## Library Statistics
A growing library of:
- **1,150** apps
- **615,900** screens
- **329,200** flows

These numbers animate with a counting effect when the section scrolls into view.

## Search Categories
Filter pill categories available for browsing design patterns:
- Profile
- Wallet
- Welcome
- Account Setup
- Home
- Subscription & Paywall
- Login
- Settings
- Checkout
- Collections

Pills are displayed in a horizontally scrollable row and update the screenshot grid when selected.

## Feature Tabs
Tab navigation options within the search feature section:
- **Screens** — Browse full-screen captures of real apps
- **UI Elements** — Explore individual components and patterns
- **Flows** — View connected sequences of screens
- **Text in Screenshot** — Search by visible on-screen copy

Clicking a tab switches the content area to show the corresponding search results view.

## Feature: Search
**Find design patterns in seconds.**
The search feature section combines the tab navigation (Screens, UI Elements, Flows, Text in Screenshot) with filter pills to let users quickly narrow down relevant design references from the library. The grid of screenshot results updates dynamically based on the active tab and selected filter category.

## Feature: Flows
**Explore entire user journeys with flows.**

- **Videos** — Experience flows the way they were meant to be experienced, complete with transitions, micro-interactions, and animations.
- **Prototype mode** — Walk through flows, step by step, by using the interactive hotspots at your own preferred pace.

A toggle switches between the Videos view and the Prototype mode view.

## Inspiration Tools
**From inspiration to creation.**

- **Copy to Figma** — Download designs you like or copy them straight into Figma with our new Figma plugin.
- **Save to collections** — Collect your favorite designs and upload your own screenshots into one place.
- **Leave comments** — Take notes upon saving so you'll never forget the context in the future.

Each tool is presented as a feature card with a visual preview and short description.

## Testimonials
**What our users are saying.**

Displayed as a multi-row, auto-scrolling marquee carousel of testimonial cards.

- **Sebastian Speier**, Shop — "ScreenVault is a great resource and it always comes in handy to see what the best practices or standards are for mobile patterns in our current landscape."
- **Meng To**, DesignCode — "ScreenVault is a game-changer for designers looking to step up their understanding of UX and UI design patterns. It's so massive, meticulously organized, has deep user flows and even a Figma plugin! It's indispensable in the modern designer's toolbox."
- **Marco Cornacchia**, Figma — "ScreenVault is one of my favorite resources for product design and UI inspo. I love having access to a ton of 'real world examples' to see how different apps and companies handle specific UI patterns and flows."
- **Daryl Ginn**, Endless — "ScreenVault has quickly become our favourite inspiration resource for designing mobile apps at endless.design, their advanced filtering is unmatched in the inspiration space."
- **Rachel How** — "ScreenVault is my go-to reference for app & web design. Apart from saving countless hours, it gives me insights on the design patterns, copywriting, and user flows of world-class products. A must-have for creative inspiration and efficiency!"
- **Haerin Song**, Visa — "By using the ScreenVault app, I save both my research time and space in my photo galleries filled with random screenshots. I love how easy it is to search for different patterns and copy and paste flows into Figma. It is a wonderful design tool you cannot live without!"

## CTA Section
**Never run out of inspiration again.**
Use ScreenVault for free as long as you like or get full access with any of our paid plans.

Primary CTA: "Join for free"
Secondary CTA: "See our plans"

Below the CTA, rows of recognizable app icons scroll in a continuous horizontal marquee animation in alternating directions. Brands include: Coinbase, Wise, Headspace, Airbnb, Uber, Nike, Pinterest, ChatGPT, Shopify, Loom, Mailchimp, Twitch, Spotify, Apple TV, Notion, Dropbox.

## Footer Navigation
**Tagline:** Design better digital experiences with ScreenVault.

Explore: Glossary · Pricing · Changelog · Blog · Colors
Contact: Help center · Careers · Merch · Support
Social: X (Twitter) · LinkedIn

© ScreenVault 2018–2026. All rights reserved · Privacy Policy · Terms

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>ScreenVault — UI & UX Design Inspiration Library</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    :root {
      --bg: #ffffff;
      --surface: #f5f5f5;
      --surface-2: #ebebeb;
      --border: #e5e5e5;
      --border-dark: #d4d4d4;
      --text: #141414;
      --text-muted: #737373;
      --text-light: #a3a3a3;
      --accent: #5b5cf6;
      --accent-hover: #4a4ae0;
      --accent-light: #eeeeff;
      --radius-sm: 8px;
      --radius: 12px;
      --radius-lg: 20px;
      --radius-xl: 28px;
      --shadow-sm: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.06), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.04);
      --shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.08), 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.04);
      --shadow-lg: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.12), 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.06);
      --font: 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
    }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      font-family: var(--font);
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--text);
      line-height: 1.6;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    /* ─── Announcement Bar ─── */
    .announcement-bar {
      background: var(--text);
      color: #fff;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 10px 1rem;
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 0.01em;
    }
    .announcement-bar a { color: #a5b4fc; text-decoration: none; margin-left: 6px; }
    .announcement-bar a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

    /* ─── Navigation ─── */
    nav {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 0 1.5rem;
    }
    .nav-inner {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      height: 60px;
    }
    .nav-logo {
      font-size: 1.0625rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--text);
      text-decoration: none;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
    }
    .nav-logo span { color: var(--accent); }
    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.25rem;
      list-style: none;
    }
    .nav-links a {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      text-decoration: none;
      padding: 6px 12px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      transition: color 150ms, background 150ms;
    }
    .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--text); background: var(--surface); }
    .nav-cta {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }
    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      font-family: var(--font);
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      border: none;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      cursor: pointer;
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: all 150ms ease;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--accent);
      color: #fff;
      padding: 9px 18px;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(91,92,246,0.4);
    }
    .btn-primary:hover {
      background: var(--accent-hover);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(91,92,246,0.35);
    }
    .btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }
    .btn-ghost {
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      padding: 9px 18px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--text); border-color: var(--border-dark); background: var(--surface); }
    .btn-lg {
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      padding: 13px 28px;
      border-radius: 10px;
    }
    .nav-mobile-toggle { display: none; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 4px; }

    /* ─── Hero ─── */
    .hero {
      padding: 5rem 1.5rem 3rem;
      text-align: center;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fafafe 0%, #ffffff 100%);
    }
    .hero-inner { max-width: 760px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      background: var(--accent-light);
      color: var(--accent);
      border: 1px solid rgba(91,92,246,0.18);
      border-radius: 100px;
      padding: 5px 14px;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }
    .hero h1 {
      font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 6vw, 3.75rem);
      font-weight: 900;
      line-height: 1.1;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
      color: var(--text);
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    }
    .hero-subtitle {
      font-size: 1.0625rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      max-width: 520px;
      margin: 0 auto 2rem;
      line-height: 1.65;
    }
    .hero-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-bottom: 3.5rem;
    }
    .hero-note {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--text-light);
      margin-top: 0.75rem;
    }

    /* Hero visual */
    .hero-visual {
      position: relative;
      max-width: 960px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .hero-browser {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg), 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.04);
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .browser-chrome {
      background: #fafafa;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 10px 16px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .browser-dots { display: flex; gap: 6px; }
    .browser-dot {
      width: 12px; height: 12px;
      border-radius: 50%;
    }
    .browser-dot:nth-child(1) { background: #ff5f57; }
    .browser-dot:nth-child(2) { background: #febc2e; }
    .browser-dot:nth-child(3) { background: #28c840; }
    .browser-url {
      flex: 1;
      background: var(--surface-2);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 6px;
      padding: 5px 12px;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      text-align: center;
    }
    .browser-content {
      padding: 1.25rem;
    }
    .screenshot-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .screenshot-card {
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      overflow: hidden;
      aspect-ratio: 9/16;
      position: relative;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--surface-2) 0%, var(--border) 100%);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transition: transform 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease;
    }
    .screenshot-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
    .screenshot-card img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
    .screenshot-shimmer {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      padding: 12px 10px;
      gap: 8px;
      height: 100%;
    }
    .shimmer-bar {
      height: 8px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--border) 0%, var(--border-dark) 50%, var(--border) 100%);
      background-size: 200% 100%;
      animation: shimmer 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    @keyframes shimmer { 0%,100% { background-position: 200% 0; } 50% { background-position: -200% 0; } }
    .shimmer-bar.short { width: 60%; }
    .shimmer-bar.medium { width: 80%; }
    .shimmer-rect {
      flex: 1;
      border-radius: 6px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--border) 0%, var(--border-dark) 50%, var(--border) 100%);
      background-size: 200% 100%;
      animation: shimmer 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
      animation-delay: var(--d, 0s);
    }

    /* ─── Trusted By ─── */
    .trusted-by {
      padding: 3.5rem 1.5rem;
      background: var(--bg);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .trusted-label {
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--text-light);
      margin-bottom: 2rem;
    }
    .marquee-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 3rem;
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
    }
    .marquee-track::before,
    .marquee-track::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      width: 80px;
      z-index: 2;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .marquee-track::before { left: 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #fff, transparent); }
    .marquee-track::after { right: 0; background: linear-gradient(270deg, #fff, transparent); }
    .marquee-inner {
      display: flex;
      gap: 3rem;
      animation: marquee-left 30s linear infinite;
      white-space: nowrap;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .marquee-inner.clone { animation: marquee-left 30s linear infinite; }
    @keyframes marquee-left {
      0% { transform: translateX(0); }
      100% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
    }
    .brand-logo {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-light);
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: color 200ms;
    }
    .brand-logo:hover { color: var(--text-muted); }
    .brand-icon {
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 14px;
    }

    /* ─── Stats ─── */
    .stats {
      padding: 5rem 1.5rem;
      background: var(--text);
      color: #fff;
    }
    .stats-inner {
      max-width: 900px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .stats-label {
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #6b7280;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }
    .stats-headline {
      font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3.5vw, 2.25rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      color: #fff;
      margin-bottom: 3.5rem;
    }
    .stats-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 2px;
    }
    .stat-item {
      padding: 2.5rem 1.5rem;
      background: #1c1c1c;
      position: relative;
    }
    .stat-item:first-child { border-radius: var(--radius) 0 0 var(--radius); }
    .stat-item:last-child { border-radius: 0 var(--radius) var(--radius) 0; }
    .stat-number {
      font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4rem);
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
      color: #fff;
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }
    .stat-number .accent { color: var(--accent); }
    .stat-desc {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: #6b7280;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* ─── Section shared ─── */
    .section { padding: 5rem 1.5rem; }
    .section-inner { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .section-tag {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--accent);
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    }
    .section-headline {
      font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 4vw, 2.75rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.035em;
      line-height: 1.15;
      color: var(--text);
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }
    .section-sub {
      font-size: 1rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      max-width: 520px;
      line-height: 1.65;
    }

    /* ─── Features: Search ─── */
    .features-search { background: var(--surface); }
    .features-search .section-inner { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 3rem; }
    .search-header { text-align: center; }
    .search-header .section-sub { margin: 0 auto; }

    /* Tabs */
    .tab-bar {
      display: flex;
      gap: 4px;
      background: var(--bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 4px;
      width: fit-content;
      margin: 0 auto 1.5rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .tab-btn {
      font-family: var(--font);
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      padding: 7px 16px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 200ms ease;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .tab-btn:hover { color: var(--text); background: var(--surface); }
    .tab-btn.active { background: var(--accent); color: #fff; }

    /* Filter pills */
    .filter-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      padding-bottom: 4px;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-bottom: 1.75rem;
    }
    .filter-row::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
    .pill {
      font-family: var(--font);
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      padding: 6px 16px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--text-muted);
      cursor: pointer;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: all 200ms ease;
    }
    .pill:hover { border-color: var(--text-muted); color: var(--text); }
    .pill.active { background: var(--text); color: #fff; border-color: var(--text); }

    /* Screenshot grid in search */
    .search-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(140px, 1fr));
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .search-card {
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      overflow: hidden;
      aspect-ratio: 9/16;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--surface-2) 0%, var(--border) 100%);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transition: transform 220ms ease, box-shadow 220ms ease, opacity 250ms ease;
      position: relative;
    }
    .search-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
    .search-card.fade-out { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.97); }
    .search-card.fade-in { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
    .card-label {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 8px;
      left: 8px;
      right: 8px;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 0.6875rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 4px 8px;
      border-radius: 5px;
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    }
    .tab-content { display: none; }
    .tab-content.active { display: block; }

    /* Elements & Flows tab content */
    .elements-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr));
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .element-card {
      background: var(--bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 1rem;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transition: box-shadow 200ms, transform 200ms;
    }
    .element-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow); transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .element-preview {
      background: var(--surface);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      height: 80px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .element-chip {
      background: var(--accent);
      color: #fff;
      border-radius: 6px;
      padding: 6px 12px;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    .element-chip.ghost { background: transparent; border: 1.5px solid var(--border-dark); color: var(--text-muted); }
    .element-name { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); }
    .element-count { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--text-light); margin-top: 2px; }

    .flows-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr));
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .flow-card {
      background: var(--bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transition: box-shadow 200ms, transform 200ms;
    }
    .flow-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow); transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .flow-screens {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      padding: 12px;
      background: var(--surface);
    }
    .flow-screen-mini {
      flex: 1;
      aspect-ratio: 9/16;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: var(--border);
    }
    .flow-info { padding: 10px 12px; }
    .flow-name { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); }
    .flow-steps { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--text-light); margin-top: 2px; }

    .text-search-box {
      background: var(--bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 1.5rem;
    }
    .text-search-input {
      width: 100%;
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border-dark);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 10px 14px;
      font-family: var(--font);
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: var(--text);
      background: var(--bg);
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color 200ms;
    }
    .text-search-input:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }
    .text-results { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(160px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
    .text-result-card {
      background: var(--surface);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      aspect-ratio: 9/16;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 1rem;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .text-highlight {
      background: #fef08a;
      color: #713f12;
      padding: 2px 6px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      font-size: 0.6875rem;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    /* ─── Features: Flows ─── */
    .features-flows { background: var(--bg); }
    .flows-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.6fr;
      gap: 4rem;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .toggle-group {
      display: flex;
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 4px;
      width: fit-content;
      gap: 4px;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }
    .toggle-btn {
      font-family: var(--font);
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      padding: 8px 18px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 200ms ease;
    }
    .toggle-btn.active { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
    .flows-feature-list { list-style: none; margin-top: 1rem; }
    .flows-feature-list li {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      align-items: flex-start;
      padding: 1rem 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .flows-feature-list li:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .feature-icon {
      width: 36px; height: 36px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: var(--accent-light);

              <h4>Videos</h4>
              <p>Experience flows the way they were meant to be — complete with transitions, micro-interactions, and animations.</p>
            </div>
          </li>
          <li id="feat-prototype" style="display:none;">
            <div class="feature-icon">◎</div>
            <div class="feature-text">
              <h4>Prototype mode</h4>
              <p>Walk through flows step by step using interactive hotspots at your own preferred pace.</p>

          </li>
        </ul>
      </div>

      <div class="flows-visual">
        <!-- Videos mode -->
        <div class="flows-visual-content" id="flowVisualVideos">
          <div style="text-align:center;">
            <div class="play-badge" aria-label="Play video">▶</div>
            <div class="phone-frame">
              <div class="phone-screen">
                <div class="phone-bar" style="width:40%;height:6px;margin-bottom:4px;"></div>
                <div class="phone-bar accent" style="height:10px;"></div>
                <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;flex:1;margin-top:8px;">
                  <div class="phone-rect" style="height:auto;"></div>
                  <div class="phone-rect" style="height:auto;background:rgba(91,92,246,.2);"></div>
                </div>
                <div class="phone-bar" style="width:80%;height:6px;margin-top:8px;"></div>
                <div class="phone-bar" style="width:55%;height:6px;margin-top:4px;"></div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <p style="color:#6b7280;font-size:0.75rem;margin-top:12px;">Onboarding · Spotify · 12 screens</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <!-- Prototype mode -->
        <div class="flows-visual-content" id="flowVisualProto" style="display:none;">
          <div style="text-align:center;width:100%;">
            <div class="phone-frame">
              <div class="phone-screen" id="protoScreen">
                <div class="phone-bar" style="width:60%;height:8px;"></div>
                <div class="phone-bar accent"></div>
                <div class="phone-rect"></div>
                <div class="phone-bar" style="width:70%;height:6px;"></div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="proto-steps" role="group" aria-label="Flow steps">
              <div class="proto-step active" data-step="1">1</div>
              <div class="proto-step" data-step="2">2</div>
              <div class="proto-step" data-step="3">3</div>
              <div class="proto-step" data-step="4">4</div>
              <div class="proto-step" data-step="5">5</div>
            </div>
            <p style="color:#6b7280;font-size:0.75rem;margin-top:12px;">Click steps to navigate the flow</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ══════════════════════════════════════ FEATURES: TOOLS ═══ -->
<section class="section features-tools" aria-label="Inspiration tools">
  <div class="section-inner text-center">
    <span class="section-tag">Tools</span>
    <h2 class="section-headline">From inspiration to creation.</h2>
    <p class="section-sub mb-0" style="margin: 0 auto;">Everything you need to turn design references into shipped products.</p>

    <div class="tools-grid">
      <div class="tool-card">
        <div class="tool-preview tool-preview-figma">
          <div class="figma-logo">
            <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 38 57" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
              <path d="M19 28.5a9.5 9.5 0 1 1 19 0 9.5 9.5 0 0 1-19 0z" fill="#1ABCFE"/>
              <path d="M0 47.5A9.5 9.5 0 0 1 9.5 38H19v9.5a9.5 9.5 0 0 1-19 0z" fill="#0ACF83"/>
              <path d="M19 0v19h9.5a9.5 9.5 0 0 0 0-19H19z" fill="#FF7262"/>
              <path d="M0 9.5A9.5 9.5 0 0 0 9.5 19H19V0H9.5A9.5 9.5 0 0 0 0 9.5z" fill="#F24E1E"/>
              <path d="M0 28.5A9.5 9.5 0 0 0 9.5 38H19V19H9.5A9.5 9.5 0 0 0 0 28.5z" fill="#A259FF"/>
            </svg>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="tool-body">
          <div class="tool-tag">Figma Plugin</div>
          <h3>Copy to Figma</h3>
          <p>Download designs you like or copy them straight into Figma with our plugin. No export, no drag-and-drop.</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="tool-card">
        <div class="tool-preview tool-preview-save">
          <div class="tool-preview-icon">🗂️</div>
        </div>
        <div class="tool-body">
          <div class="tool-tag">Collections</div>
          <h3>Save to collections</h3>
          <p>Collect your favorite designs and upload your own screenshots into one organized, searchable place.</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="tool-card">
        <div class="tool-preview tool-preview-comment">
          <div class="tool-preview-icon">💬</div>
        </div>
        <div class="tool-body">
          <div class="tool-tag">Annotations</div>
          <h3>Leave comments</h3>
          <p>Take notes upon saving so you'll never forget the context — annotate any screenshot with your own thoughts.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ════════════════════════════════════════ TESTIMONIALS ═══ -->
<section class="testimonials" aria-label="Testimonials">
  <div class="testimonials-header">
    <span class="section-tag">Testimonials</span>
    <h2 class="section-headline">What our users are saying.</h2>
  </div>
  <div class="testimonials-rows" id="testimonialsRows"></div>
</section>

<!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════ CTA ═══ -->
<section class="cta-section" aria-label="Call to action">
  <div class="cta-inner">
    <h2>Never run out of inspiration again.</h2>
    <p>Use ScreenVault for free as long as you like or get full access with any of our paid plans.</p>
    <div class="cta-actions">
      <a href="#" class="btn btn-primary-dark btn-lg btn">Join for free</a>
      <a href="#" class="btn btn-ghost-dark btn-lg btn">See our plans</a>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="app-marquees" id="appMarquees"></div>
</section>

<!-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════ FOOTER ═══ -->
<footer>
  <div class="footer-inner">
    <div class="footer-top">
      <div>
        <div class="footer-brand-logo"><span>Screen</span>Vault</div>
        <p class="footer-tagline">Design better digital experiences with ScreenVault. The world's largest searchable UI/UX inspiration library.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="footer-col">
        <h4>Explore</h4>
        <ul>
          <li><a href="#">Glossary</a></li>
          <li><a href="#">Pricing</a></li>
          <li><a href="#">Changelog</a></li>
          <li><a href="#">Blog</a></li>
          <li><a href="#">Colors</a></li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div class="footer-col">
        <h4>Contact</h4>
        <ul>
          <li><a href="#">Help center</a></li>
          <li><a href="#">Careers</a></li>
          <li><a href="#">Merch</a></li>
          <li><a href="#">Support</a></li>
          <li><a href="#">X (Twitter)</a></li>
          <li><a href="#">LinkedIn</a></li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="footer-bottom">
      <span>© ScreenVault 2018–2026. All rights reserved.</span>
      <div style="display:flex;gap:1rem;">
        <a href="#">Privacy Policy</a>
        <a href="#">Terms</a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</footer>

<!-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════ SCRIPTS ═══ -->
<script>
// ── Data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const CATEGORIES = ['Profile','Wallet','Welcome','Account Setup','Home','Subscription & Paywall','Login','Settings','Checkout','Collections'];

const SCREEN_COLORS = [
  ['#f0f4ff','#dde4ff'],['#fff0f0','#ffd6d6'],['#f0fff4','#d6f5e3'],
  ['#fffbf0','#ffecc8'],['#f5f0ff','#e8d6ff'],['#f0fbff','#d6f0ff'],
  ['#fff5f0','#ffd6c8'],['#f5fff0','#d6ffcc'],['#fff0f8','#ffd6ef'],
  ['#f0f8ff','#c8e4ff'],
];

const BRANDS = [
  {name:'Figma',icon:'🎨'},{name:'Notion',icon:'📝'},{name:'Linear',icon:'◈'},
  {name:'Vercel',icon:'▲'},{name:'Stripe',icon:'💳'},{name:'Loom',icon:'🎬'},
  {name:'Shopify',icon:'🛍'},{name:'Framer',icon:'✦'},{name:'Webflow',icon:'🌊'},
  {name:'Miro',icon:'🪄'},{name:'Airtable',icon:'📊'},{name:'Slack',icon:'💬'},
];

const TESTIMONIALS = [
  {name:'Sebastian Speier',co:'Shop',initial:'SS',color:'#7c3aed',q:"ScreenVault is a great resource and it always comes in handy to see what the best practices or standards are for mobile patterns in our current landscape."},
  {name:'Meng To',co:'DesignCode',initial:'MT',color:'#059669',q:"ScreenVault is a game-changer for designers looking to step up their understanding of UX and UI design patterns. It's so massive, meticulously organized, has deep user flows and even a Figma plugin! It's indispensable in the modern designer's toolbox."},
  {name:'Marco Cornacchia',co:'Figma',initial:'MC',color:'#dc2626',q:"ScreenVault is one of my favorite resources for product design and UI inspo. I love having access to a ton of 'real world examples' to see how different apps and companies handle specific UI patterns and flows."},
  {name:'Daryl Ginn',co:'Endless',initial:'DG',color:'#2563eb',q:"ScreenVault has quickly become our favourite inspiration resource for designing mobile apps at endless.design, their advanced filtering is unmatched in the inspiration space."},
  {name:'Rachel How',co:'Independent',initial:'RH',color:'#d97706',q:"ScreenVault is my go-to reference for app & web design. Apart from saving countless hours, it gives me insights on the design patterns, copywriting, and user flows of world-class products. A must-have for creative inspiration and efficiency!"},
  {name:'Haerin Song',co:'Visa',initial:'HS',color:'#0891b2',q:"By using the ScreenVault app, I save both my research time and space in my photo galleries filled with random screenshots. I love how easy it is to search for different patterns and copy and paste flows into Figma. It is a wonderful design tool you cannot live without!"},
];

const APP_BRANDS = [
  {name:'Coinbase',icon:'🪙',bg:'#0052ff22'},
  {name:'Wise',icon:'💚',bg:'#00b9a822'},
  {name:'Headspace',icon:'🧘',bg:'#ff702222'},
  {name:'Airbnb',icon:'🏠',bg:'#ff585822'},
  {name:'Uber',icon:'🚗',bg:'#14141422'},
  {name:'Nike',icon:'✔',bg:'#14141422'},
  {name:'Pinterest',icon:'📌',bg:'#e6000022'},
  {name:'ChatGPT',icon:'🤖',bg:'#10a37f22'},
  {name:'Shopify',icon:'🛍',bg:'#96bf4822'},
  {name:'Loom',icon:'🎬',bg:'#625df522'},
  {name:'Mailchimp',icon:'🐒',bg:'#ffe01b22'},
  {name:'Twitch',icon:'🎮',bg:'#9146ff22'},
  {name:'Spotify',icon:'🎵',bg:'#1db95422'},
  {name:'Apple TV',icon:'📺',bg:'#14141422'},
  {name:'Notion',icon:'📝',bg:'#14141422'},
  {name:'Dropbox',icon:'📦',bg:'#0061ff22'},
];

// ── Hero grid ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function buildHeroGrid() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('heroGrid');
  const colors = [...SCREEN_COLORS, ...SCREEN_COLORS.slice(0,5)];
  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
    const [c1, c2] = colors[i % colors.length];
    const delay = (i * 0.15).toFixed(2);
    grid.innerHTML += `
      <div class="screenshot-card" style="animation-delay:${delay}s;">
        <div class="screenshot-shimmer">
          <div class="shimmer-bar short" style="--d:${delay}s"></div>
          <div class="shimmer-bar medium" style="--d:${(+delay+0.1).toFixed(2)}s"></div>
          <div class="shimmer-rect" style="background:linear-gradient(160deg,${c1},${c2});animation:none;"></div>
          <div class="shimmer-bar" style="--d:${(+delay+0.2).toFixed(2)}s"></div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }
}
buildHeroGrid();

// ── Brand marquee ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
function buildBrandHTML(brands) {
  return brands.map(b => `
    <div class="brand-logo">
      <div class="brand-icon">${b.icon}</div>
      ${b.name}
    </div>`).join('');
}
const brandHTML = buildBrandHTML([...BRANDS, ...BRANDS]);
document.getElementById('brandsInner1').innerHTML = brandHTML;
document.getElementById('brandsInner2').innerHTML = brandHTML;

// ── Stats counter ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
function easeOutQuart(t) { return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 4); }
function animateCount(el, target, duration, format) {
  const start = performance.now();
  function tick(now) {
    const elapsed = now - start;
    const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
    const val = Math.round(easeOutQuart(progress) * target);
    el.textContent = format(val);
    if (progress < 1) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(tick);
}
function fmtNum(n) {
  if (n >= 1000) return (n/1000).toFixed(n % 1000 === 0 ? 0 : 1).replace(/\.0$/,'') + (n >= 1000 ? ',' + String(n % 1000).padStart(3,'0') : '');
  return n.toLocaleString();
}

let statsAnimated = false;
const statsObs = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
  if (entries[0].isIntersecting && !statsAnimated) {
    statsAnimated = true;
    const delays = [0, 200, 400];
    const targets = [{el:'statApps',val:1150},{el:'statScreens',val:615900},{el:'statFlows',val:329200}];
    targets.forEach(({el,val}, i) => {
      setTimeout(() => animateCount(document.getElementById(el), val, 2000, n => n.toLocaleString()), delays[i]);
    });
  }
}, { threshold: 0.3 });
statsObs.observe(document.getElementById('statsSection'));

// ── Tab switching ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => {
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => {
      b.classList.remove('active');
      b.setAttribute('aria-selected','false');
    });
    btn.classList.add('active');
    btn.setAttribute('aria-selected','true');
    const target = btn.dataset.tab;
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(tc => tc.classList.remove('active'));
    document.getElementById('tab-' + target)?.classList.add('active');
  });
});

// ── Search grid ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
const SCREEN_DATA = [];
CATEGORIES.forEach(cat => {
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    const [c1,c2] = SCREEN_COLORS[Math.floor(Math.random()*SCREEN_COLORS.length)];
    SCREEN_DATA.push({cat, c1, c2, label: `${cat} · ${['iOS','Web','Android'][i%3]}`});
  }
});

function buildSearchGrid(filter) {
  const grid = document.getElementById('searchGrid');
  const data = filter === 'all' ? SCREEN_DATA : SCREEN_DATA.filter(d => d.cat === filter);
  grid.style.opacity = '0';
  grid.style.transform = 'scale(0.98)';
  setTimeout(() => {
    grid.innerHTML = data.slice(0, 20).map(d => `
      <div class="search-card">
        <div style="width:100%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(160deg,${d.c1},${d.c2});display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:10px;gap:6px;">
          <div style="height:7px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.12);border-radius:4px;width:55%;"></div>
          <div style="height:7px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.08);border-radius:4px;width:70%;"></div>
          <div style="flex:1;background:rgba(0,0,0,.06);border-radius:6px;margin:4px 0;"></div>
          <div style="height:7px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.10);border-radius:4px;width:80%;"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="card-label">${d.label}</div>
      </div>`).join('');
    grid.style.transition = 'opacity 250ms ease, transform 250ms ease';
    grid.style.opacity = '1';
    grid.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
  }, 150);
}
buildSearchGrid('all');

document.querySelectorAll('.pill').forEach(pill => {
  pill.addEventListener('click', () => {
    document.querySelectorAll('.pill').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
    pill.classList.add('active');
    buildSearchGrid(pill.dataset.filter);
  });
});

// ── Flows toggle ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
document.querySelectorAll('.toggle-btn').forEach(btn => {
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    document.querySelectorAll('.toggle-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    btn.classList.add('active');
    const mode = btn.dataset.mode;
    const isVideos = mode === 'videos';
    document.getElementById('flowVisualVideos').style.display = isVideos ? 'flex' : 'none';
    document.getElementById('flowVisualProto').style.display = isVideos ? 'none' : 'flex';
    document.getElementById('feat-videos').style.display = isVideos ? 'flex' : 'none';
    document.getElementById('feat-prototype').style.display = isVideos ? 'none' : 'flex';
  });
});

// Proto steps
document.querySelectorAll('.proto-step').forEach(step => {
  step.addEventListener('click', () => {
    document.querySelectorAll('.proto-step').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
    step.classList.add('active');
  });
});

// ── Testimonials ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
function buildTestimonialCard(t) {
  return `<div class="testimonial-card">
    <div class="stars">★★★★★</div>
    <p class="testimonial-quote">"${t.q}"</p>
    <div class="testimonial-author">
      <div class="author-avatar" style="background:${t.color}">${t.initial}</div>
      <div>
        <div class="author-name">${t.name}</div>
        <div class="author-company">${t.co}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}
const row1 = TESTIMONIALS.slice(0,3);
const row2 = TESTIMONIALS.slice(3,6);
const testimRows = document.getElementById('testimonialsRows');
[row1, row2].forEach((row, i) => {
  const cards = [...row, ...row, ...row].map(buildTestimonialCard).join('');
  testimRows.innerHTML += `
    <div class="testimonial-marquee">
      <div class="testimonial-track${i===1?' rev':''}" aria-hidden="false">${cards}</div>
      <div class="testimonial-track${i===1?' rev':''}" aria-hidden="true">${cards}</div>
    </div>`;
});

// ── App icon marquee ──────────────────────────────────────────────
function buildAppIconHTML(apps) {
  return apps.map(a => `<div class="app-icon" style="background:${a.bg};" title="${a.name}">${a.icon}</div>`).join('');
}
const half = Math.floor(APP_BRANDS.length/2);
const row1Apps = APP_BRANDS.slice(0,half);
const row2Apps = APP_BRANDS.slice(half);
const marquees = document.getElementById('appMarquees');
[[row1Apps,false],[row2Apps,true]].forEach(([apps,rev]) => {
  const html = buildAppIconHTML([...apps,...apps,...apps]);
  marquees.innerHTML += `
    <div class="app-marquee-row">
      <div class="app-icon-track${rev?' rev':''}">${html}</div>
      <div class="app-icon-track${rev?' rev':''}" aria-hidden="true">${html}</div>
    </div>`;
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
